ACTION7 had no visible effect (board_changed is False). The wire is touching the green slot, but nothing has happened. Score is still 0.
Let me think about this game from a different angle. Maybe the wire is a "laser" that, when it reaches a colored slot, should "paint" the square with that color. But the square is still white.
Or maybe the goal is to move the colored slots themselves? The slots are on the right edge of the board. The tray at the bottom shows white, red, green, blue in that order. Maybe the goal is to arrange the slots in the tray's order? Currently the slots are R, b, N (top to bottom). The tray order is white, R, N, b. Hmm.
Or maybe this is a "connect the colors" puzzle: the white square is the source, and you need to extend wires to all three slots. The level is cleared when all three are connected. Currently only green is connected. Maybe the score updates when all are connected.
But wait — the wire is a single line extending from the square. To connect to red and blue as well, the square needs to be aligned with their rows. But the wire is currently connected to green. If I move the square up to the red row, will the wire follow/retract? The wire is attached to the square (extending from its right side). So: align with red (rows 19-22), extend the wire to red; align with blue (rows 25-28), extend the wire to blue. But then the green wire would be lost... unless the wire persists (like a drawn path).
Hmm, but actually, maybe each connection is recorded (like a "collected" flag), and the tray icon indicates the collection state. The tray currently shows all four icons brightly. Maybe the collected ones change appearance.
Wait, maybe I'm misreading the game. Let me reconsider: this might be a "paint" game: the white square is a paint bucket, and the wire is the paint line. The colored slots are "targets" that need to be painted white? No...
Or maybe the colored squares on the right are "keys" that need to be brought to the tray? The tray shows the same colors.
Let me look at the tray more carefully: the icons are white (M/W), R, N, b. The board has R, b, N. The tray order: white, red, green, blue. The board order (top to bottom): red, blue, green.
Maybe the puzzle is: the slots need to be rearranged to match the tray order (red, green, blue)? Currently red, blue, green. The white icon is the "player."
Hmm, but how would the player rearrange them? The wire connects to green...
Another idea: this is a "color memory" game: when the wire touches a slot, that color is "selected," and then you need to click the matching color in the tray with the mouse? Or the tray shows the sequence to follow.
Let me try: with the wire connected to green, click the green icon in the tray (row 57, column ~34). See what happens.
No wait. Let me reconsider the wire's behavior. When I first pressed RIGHT, the square moved up 1 row (31→30) and the wire extended. The square is 6 rows tall (30-35), and green is 31-34. So the square's center = 32.5, green's center = 32.5. Aligned. The wire is on rows 32-33, extending from the right edge of the square.
Maybe the game is: the wire is a "beam" and when it hits a colored slot, the slot's color gets "captured" — but the capture only happens when the beam fully overlaps the slot? The beam currently ends at column 41, and the slot is at columns 42-45. The beam is touching but not overlapping. Maybe I need one more RIGHT to push the beam into the slot, and then the square turns green (captured).
Let me try RIGHT one more time.
